messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: 5xx spike on /v1/generate (region: us-west-2). Error rate -> 18% over 5m. Auto-escalation to #incidents.
alex: seeing elevated 5xx and timeouts hitting the model-runner group. dashboard shows surge at 18:12 UTC. Customers starting to report timeouts.
maria: confirmed. 5xxs are mostly 502/504 and some segfault signatures in runtime logs. tailing logs now.
tony_sre: tagging oncall. @oncall-rota can you take lead? we should assess blast radius and put mitigation in place.
oncall-rota: taking. I’m on it. any obvious customer impact?
sarah_support: a couple of large customers reported timeouts on inference calls, thread counts dropped for a subset of workers. ticket numbers: INC-9812, INC-9813.
irene_prodeng: adding context: we rolled a modest runtime image change to quant kernels 3 hours ago. not sure if related.
ryan_runtime: looking at /var/log/model-runner/stdout: seeing repeated logs: 
```
E runtime: segfault at 0x7f8bcd
E inference: worker pid=23456 exited with signal 11
E evicting worker due to OOM (rss 42GB > limit)
```
Also seeing boost in page faults and some kernel OOM messages on node-12.
alex: node-12 has GPU mem pressure spikes. could be bad attention kernel path for certain sequences.
maria: rolling tail on k8s pods: model-runner-quant-*. Pod 3/5 show crashlooping with SIGSEGV. others show high latency.
tony_sre: immediate mitigations: 1) set traffic routing rule to divert new requests to fallback variant (cpu-quantized-v2) 2) scale up healthy pool 3) cordon node-12 4) disable new canary config. Maria, can you flip the routing?
maria: on it. running:
```
kubectl label node node-12 unschedulable=true
redwood routing set --route /v1/generate --variant cpu-quantized-v2 --weight 1.0
```
flip in progress.
ryan_runtime: also lowering per-worker concurrency from 8 -> 2 to reduce KV cache pressure: patching deploy config now.
alex: customer-facing note: Sarah, do you want a short status update?
sarah_support: yes, please. will update the open tickets: "We’re mitigating elevated error rates by routing traffic to a fallback model variant; engineers are investigating root cause. ETA 15-30m for full mitigation."
oncall-rota: cordon done. routing flip reported successful at 18:17 UTC. error rate dropping to 6% now.
incident-bot: Automation: alert suppression enabled for /v1/generate (5m) to reduce noise.
ryan_runtime: memory profiler snapshots uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incident-7162223333/profiles/. I’m grabbing a core from the crashing pod for analysis.
irene_prodeng: we should also check KV cache eviction pattern — if cache corruption triggers segfaults, fallback may avoid the path. adding an eval that reproduces long context sequences.
ton y_sre: typo in user — tony_sre: noted.
tony_sre: quick check: live metrics show p50 latency stable, p95 coming down. still some residual 502s from older pods draining. recommending we keep fallback route for next 2 hours and drain the crashloop pods.
maria: draining crashlooping pods now. `kubectl delete pod model-runner-quant-12 --grace-period=0 --force` repeated to clear.
alex: escalation: if we see repeat segfaults after rollback, we should do a hotfix to disable the new optimized attention kernels. Ryan, can you prepare a rollback patch?
ryan_runtime: yes, I have a branch that disables the attention optimization. will build a runtime image and push. ETA 20m for build+smoke.
sarah_support: updating customers: "We’ve routed traffic to a stable variant which has reduced errors; we may need 1 more hour for full recovery while we validate a runtime fix."
oncall-rota: putting incident in monitoring mode. will keep alerting on any increase >5%.
ryan_runtime: build pushed: reg.redwood/runtime:hotfix-7162223333. doing canary deploy to 2 pods.
maria: canary pods healthy after 2m smoke. no segfaults in logs so far. promoting to remaining nodes.
alex: after promotion, error rate down to 0.8% and customer tickets note improvement.
ton y_sre: tony_sre: confirming. we should capture followup action items: postmortem, revert quant kernel change permanently until we have memory-safe implementation, add kdump/core collectors on model-runner nodes, add early OOM detection alarms, add a reroute circuit breaker for new kernel flags.
irene_prodeng: I’ll own the kernel flag rollback and postmortem.
sarah_support: I’ll close/update customer tickets after 1h with final status.
oncall-rota: handed off to day SRE. moving to resolved->monitoring. great job team. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity P1 -> mitigated. Timeline: triggered 7162223333, routing flip 7162223420, hotfix promoted 7162223600.
alex: ack. final note: keep the fallback route in config for 3 hours to be safe.
